obs: - [friction] The Free plan allows 1 project and a blank 'My Project' is pre-created, so visiting New project redirected straight to the upgrade/plans page; I had to reuse 'My Project' as the client project.

- [friction] A new project is completely blank and every tool (To-dos, Docs & Files, Calendar) must be added one by one from the plus menu; my clicks on Docs & Files and Calendar while the menu stayed open after adding To-dos did not add those tools.
- [friction] Clicking the 'To-dos' title on the project card put it into rename mode (Save / Never Mind) instead of opening the tool.

- [benefit] The to-do form shows Assigned to, When done notify, Due on, Notes and Subtasks inline, and after saving one to-do it immediately opens a blank one so pressing Enter after typing a name added Beta and Gamma in one action each.
- [benefit] Typing 'Sam' in Assigned to gave an autocomplete chip in one click, and the saved to-do shows the assignee and due date as compact chips beside the name.
- [friction] Picking a due date inserted a new Repeat row that pushed the 'Add this to-do' button down, so a click aimed at its old position missed.
- [benefit] Dragging the handle on the left of Demo Gamma moved it from third to first in a single drag with no confirmation.
- [benefit] Clicking the date chip on a to-do opened an inline editor with a date picker, and changing Oct 21 to Oct 28 took two clicks (date, Save).
- [friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.
- [friction] The free plan's single pre-made 'My Project' starts with no tools, so To-dos, Message Board and Docs each have to be added one by one from an 'Add a tool' menu before any work can start.

- [benefit] One inline form held name, assignee (type-ahead 'Sam' -> Sam Rivera on Enter), 'when done' notify, due date picker, notes and subtasks, and the deliverable showed its assignee and 'Fri, Oct 30' chips on the list right after saving.
- [benefit] After saving, the form reopened for the next item, so typing a name and pressing Enter added each further deliverable in a single step.
- [friction] Setting a due date took two extra clicks (open field, pick day in calendar), and picking a date expanded the form with a Repeat row that pushed the 'Add this to-do' button down.

- [friction] There is no approval status or approval field on to-dos; the only way I found to see 'pending approval' was the to-do Filter box, a plain keyword match that showed 'Material Selection Approval' but not 'Final Blueprint Sign-off'.
